Airbyte also publishes agent-oriented docs for connecting MCP-capable agents such as Claude, Cursor and Codex. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt or how agents should use it, evidence of the file's depth or completeness (e.g. a full-content llms-full.txt), and independent user corroboration.
